lines.t:
A secondary way of using certain <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>. When
choosing a command, you can switch it on at will to
change the {{effect}} of the <c:ffff00>action<c>.

There are 5 types: <c:ffff00>Berserk<c>, <c:ffff00>Aimshot<c>, <c:ffff00>Crossfire<c>,
<c:ffff00>{{anti_air}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{anti_sea}}<c>.
